feeds.title: B-Better Blog
feeds.description: B-Better is London's street dance company. Join us for weekly dance classes in hip-hop, popping & breakin' (breakdance) plus events, performance and more!

feeds.title: The Wonderful World of Dance
feeds.description: The Wonderful World of Dance is the most beautiful dance magazine in the world, covering ballet, dance, contemporary dance, flamenco, hip hop, dance blogs, dancewear, fashion, beauty, ballet blogs, reviews, interviews, features from dancers, choreographers, artistic directors, and ballet dancers.

feeds.title: Modern Jive Dancer
feeds.description: Founder of the Modern Jive & Ceroc Blog 'Modern Jive Dancer'. My blog reviews the Classes and Freestyles we dance at and the music we dance to.

feeds.title: Dance Dispatches
feeds.description: Dance Dispatches is a blog that celebrates dance around the world. We inspect dance as a cultural art form, covering dances from ballet, modern and hip-hop to Argentine tango, flamenco and other folk dances. You'll find global news, interviews, class reviews and show reviews here.

feeds.title: Dance Consortium
feeds.description: The Dance Consortium tours international dance to large scale theatres across the UK .

feeds.title: Dance 4 Passion Blog
feeds.description: Dance4Passion is a dance school based in Scotland, covering Edinburgh, Midlothian, Livingston & Glasgow. They provide everyone with a unique experience in a delightful, friendly, fun and inspiring environment.

feeds.title: Dance in Devon
feeds.description: Dance in Devon is the countywide dance development agency for Devon. Our Vision is to create a county where people's lives are enriched and energised through dance. Our Mission is to inspire, celebrate and develop high quality dance that benefits the people of Devon and beyond.

feeds.title: Havana People
feeds.description: The number one Cuban Salsa and bachata lessons in Cardiff, Wales! Follow the blog for all your Latin Dance tips & more! Get fresh and exciting views on Salsa, Bachata, dance tips, events, and social dancing managed and written by Havana People.

feeds.title: PrincepsDance Blog
feeds.description: We offer Ballroom and Latin American Dance Classes and Private lessons from absolute beginners to competitors, wedding dance lessons and more.Our aim is to equip all students with thorough knowledge of dance, practical and theoretical, to give themstrong fundamentals in discovering their individual dance styles.

feeds.title: DYNS News
feeds.description: DYNS is a dancewear brand here to empower young women to believe that they can be and achieve anything they want, no matter what size, shape, or story. We want dancers to think big, reach for the stars and never let anyone steal their dreams. Read our blog to learn about our journey.

feeds.title: Ballet News
feeds.description: Ballet News is a professionally written website and covers professional ballet companies & vocational schools around the world. You'll find interviews, reviews, backstage, rehearsal and performance photographs, latest news updates, video clips, competitions, Ballet Business, From Student to Star and Cupcakes & Conversation, plus a whole lot more.

feeds.title: Dance Direct Blog
feeds.description: Dance Direct is Europe's largest dancewear retailer. Find news, reviews and advice about dance from this blog.
